elements.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
elements.evidence: TrueLink expressly “shall defend and indemnify Client and its affiliates.”

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
elements.evidence: The clause indemnifies Client and its affiliates against “any third-party claim” arising from the listed grounds.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Coverage includes allegations that the Interface, Hosting Services, or Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: The indemnity expressly covers third-party claims arising from “TrueLink's breach of applicable law.”

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Coverage includes unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: The indemnity expressly covers “TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct.”

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: Client must promptly notify TrueLink of any covered claim.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
elements.evidence: TrueLink has control of the defense and settlement.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: Client must provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

elements.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Client's indemnity is limited to claims relating to Client Content and violations of state or federal law, rule, or regulation by Client.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
elements.evidence: TrueLink must indemnify Client against third-party claims alleging that specified services infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-modification exclusion is imposed; the broader indemnity is consistent with this permissive element.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
elements.evidence: No Customer-combination exclusion is imposed; the broader indemnity is consistent with this permissive element.

elements.element: The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion is imposed; the broader indemnity is consistent with this permissive element.

elements.element: Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no duty to procure continued use, modify, or replace an infringing item.

elements.element: Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
elements.evidence: No refund remedy or trigger based on the unavailability of other IP remedies is stated.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered language states no three-times-annual-fees super-cap.
